Built fullstack web3 applications on the Ethereum blockchain for clients including Brian Armstrong of Coinbase, Andrew Yang, and John Pleasants & Selina Tobaccowala.

• ResearchHub (Brian Armstrong)
• Lobby3 (Andrew Yang)

positions.title: KERNEL Fellow
positions.description:
Hacked for two projects chosen for KERNEL Showcase Honors.
Nominated and invited as KB7 Guide.

Block 5 (DeFi, DAOs, NFT track)

KERNEL is a peer-to-peer learning community for unique individuals in(to) Web 3. Every cohort, 250 amazingly talented fellows from Ivy league schools, Fortune 500, Web3 Founders come together to pursue their web3 adventures and explore deeper meaning of the Web. It is a guided dance between personal motivation and web3’s potential.

positions.title: iOS Engineer
positions.description:
Tried a crypto startup leveraging token community dynamics to incentive reciprocity within communities.

Built and launched iOS app (Swift, SwiftUI)

honors.title: KERNEL Showcase Invitation
honors.description:
KERNEL is a peer-to-peer learning community for unique individuals in(to) Web 3. Every cohort, 250 amazingly talented fellows from Ivy league schools, Fortune 500, Web3 Founders come together to pursue their web3 adventures and explore deeper meaning of the Web. It is a guided dance between personal motivation and web3’s potential.


1. Each KERNEL Fellow is unique and we are a tight knit family of 900+ now. The collective creates a unique support structure for your own Web 3 adventure.
2. Result? - 30+ startups has raised 50+ MM in VC funding.
3. With the guidance of 100+ KERNEL Mentors forming our very own crypto champions league.
4. and course build across 5 Tracks lead by Industry leaders: DeFi, Token Communities, Gaming, CULTURE, Security.
